nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $H$, two number fields $K$ and $L$ of degree $n$ over $\mathbb{Q}$, each with discriminant of absolute value at most $H$, are related when there exists a ring isomorphism from $K$ to $L$.
nodes.title: Isomorphism of number fields with bounded discriminant

nodes.summary: For polynomials $E_1, \dots, E_r \in \mathbb{Q}[x_1, \dots, x_r]$, the image in the quotient ring $\mathbb{Q}[x_1, \dots, x_r]/(E_1, \dots, E_r)$ of the Jacobian determinant $\det(\partial E_i / \partial x_j)_{1 \le i, j \le r}$.
nodes.title: Jacobian determinant in the quotient ring

nodes.summary: For polynomials $E_1, \dots, E_r \in \mathbb{Q}[x_1, \dots, x_r]$, the open subscheme of $\operatorname{Spec} \mathbb{Q}[x_1, \dots, x_r]/(E_1, \dots, E_r)$ where the Jacobian determinant $\det(\partial E_i / \partial x_j)$ does not vanish, that is, the basic open set of the image of this determinant in the quotient ring.
nodes.title: The open subscheme where the Jacobian does not vanish

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $H$, the quotient of the type of number fields of degree $n$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ whose discriminant has absolute value at most $H$ by the relation of being isomorphic as rings.
nodes.title: Isomorphism classes of number fields with bounded discriminant

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $H$, the type of number fields $K$ of degree $n$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ whose discriminant $d_K$ satisfies $|d_K| \le H$.
nodes.title: Number fields of degree $n$ with discriminant bounded by $H$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the type of number fields of degree $n$ over $\mathbb{Q}$: an element is a type $K$ with a field structure making $K$ a number field (a field of characteristic zero that is finite-dimensional over $\mathbb{Q}$) such that $\dim_{\mathbb{Q}} K = n$.
nodes.title: Number fields of degree $n$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $r$ and polynomials $E_1, \dots, E_r \in \mathbb{Q}[x_1, \dots, x_r]$, the quotient ring $\mathbb{Q}[x_1, \dots, x_r]/(E_1, \dots, E_r)$ of the polynomial ring by the ideal generated by $E_1, \dots, E_r$.
nodes.title: Quotient of a polynomial ring by $r$ polynomials

nodes.summary: There is a positive integer $Q$ such that for every natural number $n \ge Q$ and every number field $K$ of degree $n$ over $\mathbb{Q}$, with discriminant $d_K$ and root discriminant $\delta_K = |d_K|^{1/n}$, there are natural numbers $r$ and $d$ with $r \le Q \log n$, $d \le Q \log n$ and $\binom{d + r}{r} \le Q n \log n$, and polynomials $E_1, \dots, E_r \in \mathbb{Z}[x_1, \dots, x_r]$ of total degree at most…
nodes.title: Couveignes: number fields have small models

nodes.summary: There is a positive integer $Q$ such that for all natural numbers $n \ge Q$ and $H \ge 1$, there are only finitely many isomorphism classes of number fields of degree $n$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ whose discriminant has absolute value at most $H$, and their number is at most $n^{Q n (\log n)^3} H^{Q (\log n)^3}$.
nodes.title: Couveignes: counting number fields with bounded discriminant

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
